ai_summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited (BEPL) reported strong year-on-year revenue growth for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, and declared a Re.1/- interim dividend, indicating solid financial health. However, its crucial Rs. 200 crore ABS production capacity expansion, aimed at increasing output to 100,000 TPA, is materially delayed from September 2026 to March 2027 due to global war-induced supply chain disruptions. This project delay, a key red flag, carries potential impacts on future growth trajectory and necessitates re-alignment of operational shutdowns to minimize production loss.
